PREDICTIVE FLOWS AND THE LEAST HIDDEN IRREVERSIBILITY
Solo construction, 31 October 2026.

1. CONTRACT AND CONSEQUENCE

The objects here are stationary DISCRETE-TIME Markov chains on arbitrary
standard-Borel state spaces, with a finite-alphabet deterministic observation
at each time. Stochastic memoryless emissions are included by adjoining an
independent emission seed. Reducible and periodic chains are allowed. Physical
time reversal is the ordinary all-even reversal, with no hidden parity map.

For stationary flow Gamma(dx,dy)=pi(dx)P(x,dy), write Gamma^T for its image
under (x,y)->(y,x). The cost is

                 e(P)=D(Gamma || Gamma^T), in nats/step.       (1)

This is path irreversibility of the Markov chain. It is not a claim about the
heat of a device without a thermodynamic model. A sampled stationary all-even
CTMC satisfies e(P_Delta)<=Delta*sigma_CT by path-space data processing, so
the bounds below also give sigma_CT>=bound/Delta. Attainment by a discrete
chain does not establish CTMC embeddability or sharpness within CTMCs.

Given the EXACT law p of a block of 2L+1 observed symbols, the problem is the
least (1) over all such hidden chains reproducing that block. No hidden-state
count, rate bound, spectral gap, finite predictive rank, preparation device,
or finite-data confidence interval is supplied as an extra premise.

Theorem. This unrestricted problem is exactly a convex minimization of
relative entropy over probability measures on a fixed COMPACT space of
forward/backward predictive probabilities and their stationary flow. Its
minimum is attained in a standard-Borel hidden model. Finite convex programs
constructed in Section 5 are valid lower bounds and converge to the minimum.

The fixed space is indexed by the OBSERVED alphabet and word length, not an
assumed number of microscopic states. This changes the inverse problem from
nonconvex fitting at a chosen hidden size to a complete, size-free convex
formulation. Its discretizations can be enormous. No polynomial runtime,
useful general statistical rate, or hardware capability is asserted.

Informed prior-exposed assessment of interim proof and scoped producer-code replay;final sources linked separately.

The central new construction replaces a chosen hidden architecture by a stationary flow on a compact space of present labels and finite forward/backward predictive probabilities. Conditional consistency is imposed against every continuous test function, not only unconditional averages. Central word probabilities become linear moments of this flow because coordinate products are fixed functions of the integration variable. Pushing a genuine hidden chain to these coordinates decreases its relative-entropy cost; disintegrating a feasible flow produces a genuine stationary Markov chain whose conditional word probabilities are the coordinates. Those two directions earn the equivalence rather than leaving realization as an assumed interface. Compactness and entropy lower semicontinuity then give attainment on standard-Borel spaces. I found no defect in this load-bearing argument at the scope of this review; no formal kernel or full independent theorem reconstruction was performed.

A second substantive element is the unbiased grid quantizer. Independent rounding of forward and backward coordinate groups preserves the data cross moments exactly, while conditional row equations incur controlled mesh error. This yields convergent finite convex lower bounds and, for rational block data, rational LP infeasibility certificates that eventually detect every exclusion of reversible hidden models. Approximate row consistency does not make a grid chain exactly reproduce the original block; the proof correctly pays its word-law discrepancy. Its full-process identity and approximate finite-state identity must retain their exact quantifiers: unpriced standard-Borel attainment is not exact finite-state attainment. Binary code uses one predictive probability per direction, with its complement implicit, which explains its162 states rather than the larger redundant general-coordinate grid.

The contract remains stationary discrete-time chains, finite observed alphabet, memoryless observation, supplied exact finite-block law and ordinary all-even reversal.
